defects_resolved.summary: M13 report claimed 6-hour Bhubaneswar trip produced Ananda Bazar (Puri, 48km away) and Bikalananda Kar Rasagola Hub (Salepur, 32km away) with fake 1-min walk hops.
defects_resolved.resolution: Calibrated RankingService proximity tiers: for days==1, Tier 0 is <= 25.0 km (immediate urban continuum), Tier 1 is <= 55.0 km, Tier 2 is <= 100.0 km. Implemented _select_clustered_places in ItineraryService: stops on a given day strictly cluster within <= 25.0 km of the day anchor. Updated AI model to resolve start location via explicit prepositions before district scanning.

defects_resolved.summary: M13 introduced 'Transit fares available at boarding. Online fare estimation is disabled.', which violated canonical transit truth rule that fares are strictly null until official tables are ingested.
defects_resolved.resolution: Replaced microcopy with canonical truth disclosure across Android (strings.xml, values-or/strings.xml) and iOS (Localizable.strings in en and or): 'Fare information unavailable. Check official or operator information before travel.' / 'ଭଡ଼ା ସୂଚନା ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ନାହିଁ। ଯାତ୍ରା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସରକାରୀ କିମ୍ବା ପରିଚାଳକ ସୂଚନା ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।' Also removed references to 'Pay on Bus'.

defects_resolved.summary: Lack of transparent disclosure that backend itinerary API models 'days' (1..7 integer) rather than sub-day hours, causing 6 hours to map to a 1-day plan with potentially infeasible pacing.
defects_resolved.resolution: Formally audited duration truth. AI intent and multilingual parser map '6 hours' / 'half day' to 1 day with pacing bounds (max 3 stops for single day). Documented API day-level granularity in M13_PLANNER_BASELINE.md and M13_1_PLANNER_TRUTH_CLOSURE.md.

defects_resolved.summary: M13 claimed 100% iOS behavioral parity without running on a macOS/Xcode runner.
defects_resolved.resolution: Calibrated all evidence and reports: iOS verification status is downgraded to SOURCE_PARITY_VERIFIED / PENDING_MACOS. Swift syntax, model bindings, and test suites are audited for exact parity with Kotlin models.

defects_resolved.summary: Claim of '10x faster trip configuration' in ponytail review without benchmark methodology.
defects_resolved.resolution: Removed '10x faster' claim from reports/mobile_v4_m13_ponytail_review.json and replaced with factual description of direct UI constraint selection versus freeform conversational typing.
